终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。

texts.zh:
我们的通讯阵列被一阵难以理解的信号狂潮淹没。在这片混沌中，一个声音开始穿透而出。

终于，你来了。不算准时，但也不算太迟。无需畏惧，我能看穿这个被我们称为现实的物质牢笼的狭隘边界。祭品已然献上，我的道路清晰可见。
texts.en:
An incomprehensible flurry of signals floods our communications array. Amid the chaos, a single voice begins to pierce through.

At last, you've come. Not punctual, but not too late either. Fear not, I see beyond the narrow bounds of this physical prison we call reality. The offering has been made. My path is clear.

texts.zh: 我们这才意识到：与我们一样，这个存在也为最光辉的灭绝事业献出了自己的视力。
texts.en: It is then we realize: like us, this being has surrendered their sight in service to the cause.

texts.zh: 这时我们才注意到，此人的眼窝空空如也，早已被摈弃。
texts.en: It is then we notice, their eye sockets are empty, long since abandoned.

texts.zh: 得了吧，别害羞。我知道你已窥见轮回之终末那超凡的简洁。与我一同共鸣，我们将共同促使它显现。
texts.en: Come now, don't be shy. I know you've glimpsed the sublime simplicity of the End of the Cycle. Join me in communion, and together we shall compel its emergence.

label.zh: 你知晓轮回之终末的存在有多久了？
label.en: How long have you known of the End of the Cycle?

responses.zh: 比我的意识更为久远。与所有心智一样，知识沉睡不显，直至虚境揭开面纱。其纯粹意图便在此刻昭然若揭。我们的目的很简单：引领终焉降临
responses.en: Longer than I've been conscious. As with all minds, the knowledge lies dormant, until the Shroud peels back the veil. There, its pure intent becomes clear. Our purpose is simple: to usher in the end

label.zh: 你为什么想要帮助我们？
label.en: Why do you want to help us?

responses.zh: 你问的正是你已知之事。我们都已目睹其必然性。崩解已然开始。唯有前行，别无他途。我们一同盘旋，终将抵达结局。
responses.en: You ask what you already know. We have both seen its inevitability. The unraveling has begun. There is no path but through. Together, we spiral toward conclusion.

responses.zh: 在这衰亡的轮回中，我不过是尘埃，众生皆是如此。我还能真正给予什么？意识正从这个星系中消逝，而我被赋予的职责是引导它们迅速离去……现在，我将这份仁慈也赐予你。
responses.en: I am but dust in this dying cycle, as are we all. What could I truly offer? Minds fade from this galaxy and I am tasked with guiding them swiftly... and I extend that mercy to you.

tooltips.zh: 奥伏戎作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Ouw'ron joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh:
凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，奥伏戎便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入虚境之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
texts.en:
All actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the Shroud.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

texts.zh:
我们与虚境的共鸣引来了一个向我们示好的新声音。它温暖、抚慰的语调在物质与精神领域同时回响。

问候。我是甘图亚塔，前来寻找那些觉醒于真道的同路人。你可曾听闻魂灵之月窠的启示？
texts.en:
Our communion with the Shroud has invited a new voice that reaches out to us. Its warm, soothing tones echo in both the physical and mental realms.

Greetings. I am Ganthuata, and I have come seeking like-minded individuals who have awoken to the true path. Have you heard the message of the Cradle of Souls?

label.zh: 我们听到了魂灵之月窠的。你为什么这么问？
label.en: We have heard the Cradle of Souls. Why do you ask?

responses.zh: 为什么？你说，旅行者为什么要向路上遇见的人提问？当然是为了理解他们所问的人，朋友。你在多嘴时，我在虚心学习。
responses.en: Why? What compels any wayfarer to question those they meet along the path? To better understand the one they seek an answer from, friend. When you speak, I learn.

label.zh: 你想要从我们这里得到什么？
label.en: What do you want from us?

responses.zh: 受月窠哺育之人，所求为何？ 首先，我寻觅的是你的友谊。 我已寻觅了一个时代，只为找到与月窠的辉煌相契合的心灵。 如今，一个完整的文明在其光芒中萌动。
responses.en: What do those nurtured by the Cradle long for? I seek your friendship, to begin with. I have searched an age for minds attuned to the Cradle's splendor, and now, a whole civilization stirs within its light.

responses.zh: 我将帮助你把讯息传遍星海。让我们携手，迎接整个星系进入月窠的温柔怀抱。
responses.en: I will help carry your message across the stars. Together, let us welcome the galaxy into the Cradle's gentle embrace.

tooltips.zh: 甘图亚塔作为一名领袖加入我们帝国。
tooltips.en: Ganthuata joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh:
战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于世界之喰煞。你也一样。
texts.en:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds. As do you.

texts.zh:
战损的铠甲、血染的披风下是一个蒙面人。一阵嘶哑的咆哮声划破了寂静。

这个星系受苦是应得的。我感觉你们也是这么想的。

这位舰队司令一边说着，[shroud_leader.GetHeShe]抚摸着一把刀刃华丽的武器的刀柄。

我被召唤到你身边，但最终我还是效忠于世界之喰煞。或许你也会这样。
texts.en:
Battle-worn armor and a blood-smeared cloak conceal a masked figure. A hoarse growl cuts through the quiet.

This galaxy deserves to suffer. I sense that you feel the same way.

As the admiral speaks, [shroud_leader.GetHeShe] strokes the hilt of an ornate bladed weapon.

I have been called to you, but ultimately I serve the Eater of Worlds. Perhaps you will too.

label.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

responses.zh: 我们携手便能扼住星海每个角落的星辰。单凭一己之力能播撒的苦难终究有限。
responses.en: Together we can choke the stars in every corner of this galaxy. There is only so much suffering one can sow on their own.

responses.zh: 世界之喰煞主宰着我的每一次呼吸。我宣誓效忠于它，并已在梦中预见此刻。侍奉您正是它的意志。若遭拒绝，我的命运便将终结。
responses.en: The Eater of Worlds commands my every breath. I am sworn to its service, and have seen this moment in my dreams. It is its will that I serve you. Your rejection would seal my fate.

label.zh: 为什么你要侍奉世界之喰煞？
label.en: Why do you serve the Eater of Worlds?

responses.zh: 我曾遭人背叛，支离破碎，被抛入痛苦的深渊。世界之喰煞向我低语。它赐予我绝境求生所需之物——染血的布条覆上淋漓的伤口。它赋予我斩断施虐之手的权能。如今，我欠下了这笔血债。
responses.en: I was betrayed, broken, and cast into agony. The Eater of Worlds spoke to me. It blessed me with what was needed to survive in that moment... a bloodied cloth over bloodied wounds. It gave me the power to sever the hands that wrought my suffering. Now, I am in its debt.

responses.zh: 我们将一同以涤荡之火洗礼无数星系，在哀嚎交响曲中喰饮饕餮盛宴。我们将目睹世界焚毁，一同向星海展示它永世难忘之景。此乃吾等宿命。
responses.en: Together, we will bathe countless systems in cleansing flames, and feast on a symphony of screams. We will watch worlds burn. Together, we will show the galaxy things it can never forget. This is our destiny.

tooltips.zh: 科博洛可-拉作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Koborok'Ra joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh:
莫尔的眼光永远在扫视着，在光影之间游离，如同永恒的狩猎一般。

你也感受到了，对吧？渴求之器具永恒变化。它渴望着、吞噬着、命令着。

我会夺走所见的一切。大自然的一切馈赠都逃不过我。我为你服务，不是出于忠诚，而是因为我们可以一起扫清群星，填补应有的虚空。
texts.en:
Morr's gaze never settles, flitting from shadow to shine, as if forever hunting.

You feel it too, don't you? The Instrument of Desire is never still. It craves. It devours. It commands.

What I see, I take. No bounty of nature has withstood my will. I offer you my service, not out of loyalty, but because together, we can raze the stars and feed the void its due.

label.zh: 你们为什么要加入我们？
label.en: Why do you wish to join us?

responses.zh: 渴求之器具永不满足。祂需要许多双[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]的劳作才能取悦祂。
responses.en: The Instrument of Desire is quenchless. It requires the work of many [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] to please it.

responses.zh:
我可以帮你提取自然界中每一个有利可图的分子。每一个原子都会被认领、标记、贩卖。

知足就是懦弱。真是可悲。让那些人腐烂吧，让我们一起征服一切。
responses.en:
I can help you extract every last monetizable molecule nature possesses. Not a single atom will go unclaimed, unbranded, or unsold.

Those who whisper 'enough' are cowards. Pathetic. Let them rot. Together we will take it all.

label.zh: 为什么你要侍奉渴求之器具？
label.en: Why do you serve the Instrument of Desire?

responses.zh:
我曾经是一名勘探者，追逐着繁星能给予的一切矿物。灰尘弥漫的空气，坏掉的扫描仪，空洞的声明……然后渴求之器具开口了。

祂承诺带来难以想象的财富，所要求的只是忠诚。

如今我效忠、提取、供奉。债务是永恒的……但是财富？财富永无止境。
responses.en:
I was once a prospector, chasing every mineral rush the stars could throw at me. Dust-choked air, broken scanners, empty claims... until the Instrument of Desire spoke.

It promised wealth beyond comprehension. All it asked for was allegiance.

Now I serve. I extract. I deliver. The debt is eternal... but the riches? Oh, the riches never end.

tooltips.zh: 莫尔作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Morr joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh:
当我们的敏感器侦测到一艘飞船正突破边界时，一个紧绷的声音回荡在虚境——疲惫、尖锐，却带着令人不安的熟悉感，如同生命之织缕的低鸣。

新生的……[GetKronenFlesh]？有趣。如此柔软。如此……可塑。还是说并非如此？难以断言。无数扭结在[GetKronenSkin]之下蠕动。今日生命之织缕为我编织了何等形态？

通讯终于稳定，显露出一个由原生蠕动的肌肉构成的身影——痉挛着，癫狂书写。

你目睹了我的本相。或许我仍是受苦者克罗南，或许已非。但我能感知你，如我一般，是铺展在织缕之主笔下的画布。来吧。让我们开始揭幕。
texts.en:
As our sensors detect a vessel breaching our borders, a strained voice echoes across the Shroud - tired, shrill, yet disturbingly familiar, like the hum of the Composer of Strands.

New... [GetKronenFlesh]? Intriguing. So soft. So... mutable. Or is it? Hard to say. So many knots shifting beneath the [GetKronenSkin]. What form has the Composer of Strands spun for me today?

The comms finally stabilize, revealing a figure of raw, shifting muscle - convulsing, scribbling frantically.

You see me, as I am. Perhaps I am still Kronen the Afflicted. Perhaps not. But I feel you, like me, a canvas stretched for the Composer's brush. Come. Let us begin the unveiling.

responses.zh: 为何，当然是蜕变了。抛弃这些粗糙、不完美的躯壳。解开将我们束缚于形态、束缚于确定的丝缕。织缕之主的刻印也在你身上。你早已开始……难道没感觉到它在你的[GetSkinType]下悸动吗？
responses.en: Why, the shedding, of course. The discarding of these crude, imperfect husks. The unweaving of the strands that bind us to shape, to certainty. The Composer's touch is upon you, too. You've already begun... haven't you felt it twitching beneath your [GetSkinType]?

label.en: Why do you want to join us?

responses.zh: 你感受不到吗？那印记，深烙在每一根颤动的丝缕中。我必须拆解自身，褪去旧我，见证自我崩解的过程，撕开缝合血肉的针脚。但你……你是一个帝国。浩瀚无垠。无所不能。若我们联手，便能牵动远超你我独自所能企及的宏大脉络。
responses.en: You don't feel it? The mark, pressed into every trembling strand. I must unravel, shed what I was, witness my unbecoming as I tear free the stitches that bind me to flesh. But you... you are an empire. Vast. Capable. Together, we could tug at threads far greater than either of us could grasp alone.

responses.zh: 我所给予的不只是帮助。我的血肉是一份礼物，一场关于痛苦与意义的实验，由生命之织缕亲手雕琢。我的每一寸纤维都在嘶吼，但我承受着。我研究。我学习。而我所有苦难的结晶……皆由你来塑造。只要我们共同塑造它。
responses.en: I offer more than help. My flesh is a gift, an experiment in pain and purpose, sculpted by the Composer of Strands. Every fiber of me screams, but I endure. I study. I learn. And all that my suffering yields... is yours to shape. So long as we shape it together.

tooltips.zh: 受苦者克罗南作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Kronen the Afflicted joins our empire as a Leader.

texts.zh:
通讯阵列突然刺啦作响，一个声音带着诡异的紧迫感低语道。

向你致意，同频的聆听者。我在喧嚣中听见了你的声音——不，是*众声*。你现在也听见它们了吧？虚空之低语的宏大合唱，他们窃窃私语的馈赠，他们呢喃的癫狂？

此等奥秘对无力参悟之人尤为凶险。但我可助你抽丝剥茧。当你面对撕扯思维的悖论洪流时，我愿施以援手。无意冒犯。曾几何时，就连我也难以参透其真意。
texts.en:
The communication array crackles to life as a voice murmurs with eerie urgency.

Greetings, fellow listener. I heard your voice - no, *voices* - amid the cacophony. You hear them too now, don't you? The great chorus of the Whisperers in the Void, their hushed gifts, their murmured hysteria?

Such secrets are perilous to those who cannot comprehend them. But I can help you unravel them. I offer my aid as you face the overwhelming flood of paradoxes clawing at your thoughts. No insult meant. Once, even I struggled to understand their true meanings.

label.zh: 为什么你觉得你可以帮得上忙？
label.en: What makes you think you can help?

responses.zh:
你已突破虚境的帷幕，不是吗？但告诉我，你可曾真正掌控它？我穷尽一生勘测其深渊，绘制其中不可名状的实体轨迹，以及它们在我们脆弱世界的回响。

低语之主始终指引着我。那些如今充斥你思维的癫狂呢喃？我能助你理解它们。
responses.en:
You've pierced the veil of the Shroud, haven't you? But tell me, have you mastered it? I have spent a lifetime charting its depths, mapping the unfathomable drift of its entities and their echoes upon our fragile realm.

The Whisperers have long guided me. Every maddening utterance now crowding your thoughts? I can help you understand them.

label.zh: 你对于低语之主有何了解？
label.en: What do you know of the Whisperers?

responses.zh: 多年来，我一直在记录祂的低语，等待的就是这一刻。如今你已与他们纷繁的合唱同频共振，我绝不会浪费这个机会，去挖掘深埋其中的真相。
responses.en: I have catalogued their whispers for years, waiting for this very moment. Now you are aligned with their manifold chorus, and I will not waste this chance to glean the truths buried within.

responses.zh:
毕生的钻研磨砺出我的专注，让我得以解析物质现实的构造与虚境那无垠的深渊。

我们将共同突破此位面的桎梏。宇宙的奥秘终将被我们揭开。我以绝对的确定性向你们承诺。
responses.en:
A lifetime of study has honed my focus, unraveling the structures of our physical reality and the boundless depths of the Shroud.

Together, we will break free from the limits of this plane. The secrets of the universe will be ours to uncover. That, I promise, with absolute certainty.

tooltips.zh: 聆听者祖琳作为一名领袖加入了我们的帝国。
tooltips.en: Zulyn the Listener joins our empire as a Leader.
